description: Triage one commercial-property submission: load it (with its documents and claims) from the stores, compute the deterministic missing-required-documents check in code, delegate the underwriting judgment to the underwriting-reviewer subagent, then record the finding and stamp the submission. Returns the saved finding. Recommends a workflow status for a human underwriter; never binds coverage or prices premium. Reports found: false when the submission id is unknown.

submission_id.description: The submission to triage, e.g. sub_bistro_ember.
